items.title: File Widerspruch against the Elterngeld decision
items.quote: Er ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Eifel, Elterngeldstelle, Moselufer 31, 56812 Musterburg an der Mosel, einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Tue 04.02.2025. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter sent by ordinary post from a social-law authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sat 08.02.2025 (this day does not shift even though it falls on a Saturday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after deemed delivery, so it runs from 09.02.2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the starting event, i.e. Sat 08.03.2025. Since 08.03.2025 is a Saturday, § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X shifts the deadline to the next working day, Monday 10.03.2025.

warnings: The letter prints an IBAN for the Kreisverwaltung's own account; this is not an account the recipient needs to pay into, and no payment is demanded from the recipient in this letter.

For the first two Lebensmonate no Elterngeld is paid (0,00 €) because Mutterschaftsgeld and the employer's Zuschuss were offset against it; the person should check this offset against their own Mutterschaftsgeld/payslip records.
